fields.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Ahl al-Raʾy attack Ahl al-Ḥadīth
fields.body:
🖋️ **Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī** said:

> ***“Abū Ḥātim ar-Rāzī said in meaning: The sign of Ahl al-Raʾy is slandering Ahl al-Ḥadīth.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The early warning shows: When opinion is placed above transmission, the attack on Ahl al-Ḥadīth often becomes the method.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah, Iʿtiqād Abī Zurʿah wa Abī Ḥātim.
